```yaml
name: CDK source connector compatibility test

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-toolkit/**'
      - 'tools/**'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source/**'
      - 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/source-toolkit/**'
      - 'tools/**'

jobs:
  get_connectors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      connectors: ${{ steps.get_connectors.outputs.connectors }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Get certified source connectors
        id: get_connectors
        run: |
          connectors=$(./tools/bin/bulk-cdk/get-certified-connectors.sh sources)
          echo "connectors=$(python -c 'import json, sys; print(json.dumps(sys.stdin.read().splitlines()))' <<< "$connectors")" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

  test:
    needs: get_connectors
    if: needs.get_connectors.outputs.connectors != '[]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        connector: ${{ fromJSON(needs.get_connectors.outputs.connectors) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd airbyte-integrations/connectors/${{ matrix.connector }}
          make test
      - name: Upload test results
        uses: dorny/test-reporter@v1
        with:
          name: 'Test results'
          path: 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/${{ matrix.connector }}/test-results.xml'
          reporter: 'java-junit'
      - name: Upload to Codecov
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          directory: 'airbyte-integrations/connectors/${{ matrix.connector }}/'
          files: 'test-results.xml'
          fail_ci_if_error: true
```
